sentences.text: Fossil remains consisting of a skull with a jaw have been found in the Adamantina Formation of Brazil.
Gondwanasuchus belongs to the family Baurusuchidae and is classified within the subfamily Pissarrachampsinae.
The genus Gondwanasuchus was described by Marinho, Iori, Carvalho, and Vasconcelos in 2013.
The type species of the genus Gondwanasuchus is Gondwanasuchus scabrosus.
Gondwanasuchus lived during the Campanian to Maastrichtian stages, between 83.6 and 66 million years ago.
Recent studies concluded that Gondwanasuchus is a juvenile specimen of a larger Baurusuchid species, making it a nomen dubium.
